title: Authentication basics

spans.text: FastAPI builds JSON APIs that web and mobile applications call over HTTP; type annotations help validate inputs and describe the API contract.

Authentication checks who made a request; authorization decides what that identity may access. In a bearer-token flow, the client sends a token and FastAPI extracts it before the endpoint. The fixed token below is for a lesson demo only.
To run these examples locally, install
plus any extra package named in the lesson. Save the server example as

WHERE DOES THIS APPEAR IN REAL LIFE?
A private profile endpoint rejects requests without a token and returns data for an identified user.
If this part is omitted: Without identity checks, anyone who can reach the endpoint may receive protected data; do not infer identity from a request.
QUESTION: What will this code print? Predict first, then run it.

spans.code:
import secrets
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

app = FastAPI()
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")

async def current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)):
    if not secrets.compare_digest(token, "development-only-token"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid token", headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})
    return {"username": "ada"}

@app.get("/profile")
async def profile(user: dict = Depends(current_user)):
    return user

Request: GET /profile  Authorization: Bearer development-only-token
Response: Demo token returns 200 JSON; a missing token returns 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`.

import secrets
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

app = FastAPI()
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")

async def current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)):
    if not secrets.compare_digest(token, "development-only-token"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid token", headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})
    return {"username": "ada"}

@app.get("/profile")
async def profile(user: dict = Depends(current_user)):
    return user

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

with TestClient(app) as client:
    response = client.get("/profile", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer development-only-token"})
    print(response.status_code, response.json())

spans.title: Practical tip
spans.text: Use Authorize in `/docs` to send a bearer token; test missing and incorrect tokens as separate 401 cases.

spans.title: One level deeper
spans.text: Authentication and authorization are different. A valid identity is not permission for every action; also check ownership and roles.

spans.title: Important warning
spans.text: This fixed token is intentionally not secure. Use a standard OAuth2/OIDC provider, TLS, expiry/rotation, and secret management in a real system.
